name: Search for Incendicite
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear seeks samples of volatile incendicite ore from the Wetlands. He believes its explosive force could change dwarven artillery, and needs you to reach a secluded cave and bring back the dangerous mineral.

sections.title: A Volatile Discovery
sections.body: Siege engine pilots and mechanics at Steelgrill's Depot have heard of rare, unstable ore. Rich veins are rumored in a cavern northwest of Algaz Gate, in the Wetlands. Careless miners there risk having the reactive mineral detonate in their faces.

sections.title: Munitions of Tomorrow
sections.body: Pilot Stonegear sees military promise in the ore. Refined correctly, it could power dwarven artillery or serve as its payload. Cannon shells might gain enough force to break fortified defenses. He wants raw samples so researchers can test smelting methods without blowing up the depot.

faq.q: What is incendicite ore used for?
faq.answer: Incendicite is an intensely volatile, explosive mineral. Pilot Stonegear wants to test smelting methods that could make it powerful artillery ammunition for cannon shells.
The ore lies in a cave system northwest of Algaz Gate, in the southern mountains of the Wetlands.

Pilot Stonegear is a dwarven siege engine pilot with the Ironforge Siege Brigade. He is stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, where he works with mechanics and siege engineers to improve dwarven war machines.

faq.q: Why does harvesting this ore require a pickaxe?
faq.answer: Incendicite lies in raw mineral veins, not loose on the surface. Miners need a practiced hand with a pick to chip the brittle, explosive ore from rock without setting it off.
No. Incendicite is notoriously unstable and may detonate during excavation, transport, or smelting.

faq.q: How does this connect to Stonegear's Search?
faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard or Mountaineer Kadrell sends you to Steelgrill's Depot after Pilot Stonegear hears rumors of rare ore and wants someone to find it. This follows 'Stonegear's Search'.

angles.text: As a miner, you need practiced hands to extract incendicite with a pick. Its volatility makes careful work essential.
As a dwarf, you come from a people known for advancing gunpowder and artillery. Incendicite shells fit Khaz Modan's siege traditions.
As an engineer, you know the risk of explosive compounds comes with seeking the next great blast.
